components.purpose: Buttons start an action: send money, confirm a transfer, freeze a card. The label always says what happens next.
whenToUse: To start an action on the current screen, such as Send, Save or Confirm.
To submit a form (`type="submit"`).
For the single most important action of a screen or section, with `variant="primary"`.
whenNotToUse: To go to another page: use Link.
For icon-only actions: use IconButton, and never for moving money.
For on and off settings: use Switch.
contentGuidelines: Start with a verb and say the outcome: "Send ₺250", "Freeze card", "Download PDF".
Use sentence case, two or three words.
Put the amount in the label of money actions when it helps people check it.
sizes: `xs`: 32 px (compact 28): Dense tables and toolbars on desktop.
`sm`: 36 px (compact 32): Inside cards and list rows.
`md`: 44 px (compact 40): Default for forms and dialogs.
`lg`: 48 px (compact 44): Main actions on mobile screens.
`xl`: 56 px (compact 48): The last step of a mobile flow, usually `fullWidth`.
do: Use one primary button per screen or section.
Keep the primary action on the right in dialogs and at the bottom on mobile.
Use `loading` while an action runs.
dont: Do not use `danger` for normal payments: sending money is not an error.
Do not put two primary buttons next to each other.
Do not disable a submit button to hide errors: let people submit and show what to fix.
Do not use a button for navigation.
Do not mix rounded and pill buttons in one group, or put a pill button inside a form row next to rounded fields.
accessibility: Native `<button>` with `type="button"` by default.
Loading uses `aria-busy` and `aria-disabled`, keeps focus and keeps the accessible name.
Focus uses the `elevation.focus` ring: 3:1 against every surface.
Text on every variant passes WCAG 2.2 AA in every brand and mode.
keyboard: Tab: Moves focus to the control

props.description: Tabular figures, for numbers that line up in columns.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Cut to one line with an ellipsis.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Other native props are passed to the root element.

components.purpose: Body text, labels, subtitles, captions and inline code, using the type roles and text tones of the system.
whenToUse: Paragraphs, labels, helper lines, captions and numbers in lists.
whenNotToUse: Headings: use Heading so the page outline is correct.
Amounts: use AmountDisplay so signs and formatting are right.
contentGuidelines: Keep sentences short and in second person.
Use `tabular` for numbers that line up in columns.
Never use em dashes in copy: use commas, colons or periods.
do: Pick `as` for meaning: `p` for paragraphs, `span` inline, `label` with `htmlFor`.
Use `secondary` for supporting text and `tertiary` only for hints and captions.
dont: Do not use `success` or `danger` tones as the only signal of state: add an icon or words.
Do not set font sizes by hand.
accessibility: Every tone passes WCAG 2.2 AA on every surface in every brand and mode.
Text follows the browser font size because sizes are in rem.

components.name: TextField

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Required: placeholders are not labels.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and links the message to the input.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Short text or symbol before the value, for example "₺".

props.name: numeric
props.description: Use tabular figures, for amounts and codes.

props.name: size
props.description: sm 36 px, md 44 px (default, touch friendly), lg 48 px.

props.name: shape
props.description: rounded: the size's control radius. pill: fully rounded ends, to sit next to pill buttons, for example in a search bar.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Other native props are passed to the root element.

components.purpose: Single-line text input with a visible label, hint, error, and optional prefix or suffix.
whenToUse: Names, IBANs, references, search, short answers.
whenNotToUse: Money: use AmountInput.
One-time codes: use OTPInput.
Long text: use Textarea.
contentGuidelines: Labels name the value: "IBAN", not "Enter your IBAN".
Hints explain format before people type: "26 characters, starts with TR".
Errors say what is wrong and how to fix it: "This IBAN is too short. Check it and try again."
sizes: `sm`: 36 px (compact 32): Dense desktop forms. Keeps a 44 px hit area and 16 px text on touch screens.
`md`: 44 px (compact 40): Default. Same height as a md Button.
`lg`: 48 px (compact 44): Main field of a screen, such as an amount.
do: Always set a visible label.
Use the right `inputMode` and `autoComplete`.
dont: Do not use the placeholder as a label.
Do not blame people in errors ("Invalid input").
accessibility: Label linked with `htmlFor`.
Hint and error linked with `aria-describedby`; error sets `aria-invalid`.
Errors use an icon, text and a thicker border, never color alone.

components.name: Textarea

props.name: showCount
props.description: Shows "12 of 140" and announces it politely as people type.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Other native props are passed to the root element.

components.purpose: Multi-line text for payment notes and messages. It grows with its content.
whenToUse: Payment notes, messages to support, descriptions.
whenNotToUse: Single-line values: use TextField.
contentGuidelines: Tell people who sees the text: "The recipient sees this".
Show the limit with `maxLength` and `showCount`.
do: Mark it `optional` when it is.
dont: Do not use it to collect structured data such as addresses.
accessibility: Visible label, hint and error linked like TextField.
The counter is announced politely as people type.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: A short confirmation after an action, such as "Money sent". Shown with `useToast` inside `ToastProvider`.
whenToUse: Confirming that something finished.
Offering an undo for a reversible action.
whenNotToUse: Errors inside forms: show them on the field.
Anything people must act on: use Alert or Dialog.
contentGuidelines: Title says what happened in two or three words.
Description adds one useful detail.
do: Wrap the app once in `ToastProvider`.
dont: Do not put the only way to do something in a toast.
accessibility: Radix Toast region with a label. Danger toasts are announced assertively.
Each tone shows its icon in a tinted circle next to the title, never color alone.
keyboard: F8: Moves focus to the toast region

components.name: Tooltip

props.name: content
props.description: Extra information only. Never put required information or actions in a tooltip.

props.name: children
props.description: A single focusable element.

components.purpose: Extra information on hover and keyboard focus. Wrap the app once in `TooltipProvider`.
whenToUse: Naming an icon-only control.
A short explanation that is nice to have.
whenNotToUse: Required information, fees or errors.
Touch-first screens, where hover does not exist: show the text inline.
contentGuidelines: One short sentence, no actions or links.
do: Wrap a single focusable element.
dont: Do not wrap disabled buttons: they cannot receive focus.
accessibility: Shows on focus and hover, hides on Escape.
Content is linked to the trigger.

components.name: AccountCard

props.name: name
props.description: For example "Everyday account".

props.name: type
props.description: For example "Current account" or "Savings".

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to three quick actions.

props.name: masked
props.description: Hide the balance digits.

props.name: footer
props.description: Extra content under the balance, for example an interest rate.

components.purpose: An account summary: name, type, masked IBAN, balance and up to three quick actions.
whenToUse: Home and accounts screens.
whenNotToUse: Account details: show the full IBAN on its own screen.
contentGuidelines: Name is the person's own name for the account: "Everyday".
Action labels are verbs: Send, Add money, Details.
do: Give each action a text label. The first one is primary.
dont: Do not show the full IBAN on the card.
accessibility: Article named by account name and type.
IBAN is masked visually and read as "IBAN ending in 1 3 2 6".

components.name: AmountDisplay

props.name: value
props.description: Positive number. Direction decides the sign. Negative values are treated as outgoing.

props.name: direction
props.description: incoming: plus sign and teal. outgoing: minus sign and ink, never red. neutral: no sign, for balances.

props.name: size
props.description: xl for the hero balance, lg for account cards, md and sm for lists.

props.name: pending
props.description: Not settled yet. Adds a clock icon and a "Pending" label.

props.name: masked
props.description: Replace digits with dots, for example when the user hides balances.

components.purpose: Every amount and balance in Leeward: locale formatting, tabular figures and a direction that never relies on color.
whenToUse: Balances, transaction amounts, fees, totals.
whenNotToUse: Typing amounts: use AmountInput.
contentGuidelines: tr-TR with TRY shows ₺1.250,00. en-US with TRY shows TRY 1,250.00. Foreign currencies always use the code.
Show fees at the same size as the amount they belong to.
sizes: `sm`: 16 px: Lists.
`md`: 20 px: Cards and summaries.
`lg`: 28 to 36 px, fluid: Account cards.
`xl`: 36 to 51 px, fluid: The hero balance.
do: Pass a positive `value` and set `direction`.
dont: Do not color outgoing amounts red.
Do not format amounts by hand or with `toFixed`.
accessibility: Screen readers hear one phrase: "Money in: 1,250.00 Turkish lira".
Visual text is hidden from assistive tech to avoid reading symbols.

components.name: AmountInput

props.name: value
props.description: Amount in major units (lira, not kuruş). null when empty.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum allowed, for example the available balance. Going over shows an error.

props.name: error
props.description: Overrides the built-in error.

components.purpose: Money entry with the decimal keypad on phones, locale formatting on blur and a clear limit error.
whenToUse: Transfer amounts, top ups, savings deposits.
whenNotToUse: Non-money numbers: use TextField with `numeric`.
contentGuidelines: Show the available balance in `hint`.
Built-in errors explain the limit: "This is more than you have. You can send up to ₺24.580,35."
sizes: Field: 48 px: Always the large field size.
do: Pass `max` as the available balance.
dont: Do not block typing: show the error and let people fix it.
accessibility: `inputMode="decimal"` opens the number keypad.
The error is linked to the field.

components.name: BalanceHeader

props.name: label
props.description: For example "Available balance".

props.name: hidden
props.description: Controlled hidden state.

props.name: meta
props.description: Supporting line, for example "Updated 2 minutes ago".

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions under the balance, usually Buttons with text labels.

components.purpose: The account balance at the top of home and account screens, with a hide and show control.
whenToUse: Once per screen, at the top.
whenNotToUse: Lists of balances: use AmountDisplay in rows.
contentGuidelines: Label says which balance: "Available balance".
Meta says how fresh it is: "Updated just now".
do: Keep the toggle: people check balances in public.
dont: Do not hide the label when the balance is hidden.
accessibility: Region named by the label.
The toggle uses `aria-pressed` and changes its label; hidden balances read "Balance hidden".

components.name: OTPInput

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once when every digit is filled.

components.purpose: One-time code entry with paste, SMS autofill and clear errors.
whenToUse: Confirming a transfer or a login with an SMS code.
whenNotToUse: Passwords and PINs that people choose.
contentGuidelines: Say where the code was sent in `hint`: "We sent a code to •••• 4821".
sizes: Box: 48 px: Six boxes by default, `length` changes it.
do: Use `onComplete` to verify automatically.
dont: Do not split the code into separate inputs.
Do not clear the code on error.
accessibility: `autocomplete="one-time-code"` and `inputMode="numeric"`.
The error is linked to the input.

components.name: PaymentCard

props.name: name
props.description: For example "Everyday debit" or "Travel card".

props.name: last4
props.description: The last four digits only. Never pass the full card number.

props.name: expiry
props.description: "MM/YY".

props.name: type
props.description: Network or type shown in the corner, for example "Debit" or "Virtual".

props.name: bank
props.description: Bank name on the card. Defaults to "Leeward".

components.purpose: Card artwork with the masked number, card name, holder and expiry, and a clear frozen state.
whenToUse: Cards screens, card details and card settings.
Confirming which card a setting applies to, for example when freezing a card.
whenNotToUse: Picking a card from a long list: use ListItem rows with the card name and last four digits.
contentGuidelines: Name cards by use: "Everyday debit", "Travel card".
Expiry is "MM/YY".
do: Put card actions (Freeze, Show details) as Buttons next to the card, not on it.
Show the frozen state on the card itself, so people see it where they look.
dont: Do not pass or show the full card number or the CVV on this component.
Do not show frozen with color alone: the badge says it in words.
accessibility: An article named in one sentence: card name, "Card ending in 4 8 2 1", expiry and "Frozen" when it is.
The visual details are hidden from screen readers so they are not read twice.
Text sits on the primary fill using the color made for it, so contrast passes in every brand and mode.

components.name: QuickActions

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, for example "Quick actions".

components.purpose: A row of shortcuts such as Send, Request, Top up and Pay bills. It wraps on narrow screens.
whenToUse: Home screens, under the balance.
whenNotToUse: More than four shortcuts on phones.
contentGuidelines: One or two words per action.
Use `badge` only for a count that needs attention.
do: Use duotone icons that match the label.
dont: Do not use icon-only shortcuts: every action has a text label.
accessibility: A labelled list of buttons or links.
Each target is at least 44 px.

components.name: RecipientRow

props.name: name
props.description: The person's or company's name, as saved.

props.name: bank
props.description: Bank name, for example "Leeward" or "Ziraat Bankası".

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Photo or logo. Initials are shown without it.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Choose this recipient. Renders the row as a button.

props.name: href
props.description: Open the recipient's page. Renders the row as a link.

components.purpose: A saved recipient: avatar, name, bank and masked IBAN. Choosing the row starts a transfer to them.
whenToUse: Recipient pickers in a transfer flow.
Lists of saved recipients and favorites.
whenNotToUse: Past transactions: use TransactionRow.
Your own accounts: use AccountCard.
contentGuidelines: Use the name the person saved, not the legal account holder name, when they differ.
Always show the last four IBAN digits so people can tell two recipients apart.
do: Put favorites first.
Use inside List so rows get dividers and spacing.
dont: Do not show the full IBAN in a list.
Do not make the row and a button inside it do different things.
accessibility: The IBAN is masked visually and read as "IBAN ending in 1 3 2 6".
The favorite star has text for screen readers, not color or shape alone.
The avatar is decorative because the name is next to it.

components.name: SavingsGoal

props.name: name
props.description: For example "Holiday fund".

props.name: icon
props.description: One of the names in `icons` at the top of this manifest.

props.name: onAddMoney
props.description: Shows an "Add money" button.

components.purpose: A savings goal: what people saved, the target, progress and the date they want to reach it.
whenToUse: Savings screens and the home screen, one card per goal.
whenNotToUse: Spending limits: use ProgressBar with a warning tone and words.
Account balances: use AccountCard.
contentGuidelines: Name goals in the person's words: "Holiday fund", "New laptop".
Show the date as a full date: "By 1 June 2027".
do: Offer "Add money" on the goal itself.
Keep amounts in the goal's currency.
dont: Do not color the bar red when people are behind: saving less is not an error.
accessibility: An article named by the goal.
The progress bar has a visible label ("Progress") and value text, so progress is never shown by color alone. The goal name comes from the article.

components.name: SpendingBreakdown

props.name: title
props.description: For example "Spending in November".

components.purpose: Spending by category for a period: the total, one bar that shows the shape, and a list with names, amounts and shares.
whenToUse: Monthly spending insights and budget screens.
whenNotToUse: Trends over time: use a line chart.
A single limit: use ProgressBar.
contentGuidelines: Title names the period: "Spending in November".
Category names are short and familiar: "Groceries", "Transport".
do: Keep the list next to the bar: it is the readable version of the chart.
Limit the list to the main categories and group the rest as "Other".
dont: Do not use red for spending: spending money is not an error.
Do not show the bar without the list.
accessibility: A section named by its title. The bar is hidden from screen readers; the list carries every value.
Each row reads name, share ("32% of total") and amount, so color is never the only signal.
In forced colors mode the bar and swatches get outlines.

components.name: SummaryList

props.name: total
props.description: Emphasized last row with a line above it, for example the total that leaves the account.

components.purpose: Label and value pairs that let people check a transfer before they send it, or read a receipt after.
whenToUse: The review step of a transfer or payment: recipient, amount, fee, arrival time, total.
Receipts and transaction details.
whenNotToUse: Lists people choose from: use List and ListItem.
Long forms: show the fields, not a summary.
contentGuidelines: Labels are short nouns: "Recipient", "Fee", "Arrives".
Show the fee even when it is zero: "₺0,00", with a hint that says why.
The total is the exact amount that leaves the account.
do: Put the total last and make it the amount people approve.
Use AmountDisplay for amounts so signs and formatting stay consistent.
dont: Do not hide fees or exchange rates in a hint or tooltip.
Do not use the summary for editable values: link back to the step instead.
accessibility: A description list (`dl`, `dt`, `dd`), so screen readers announce each label with its value.
The total row is a normal row with stronger styling, read in order.

components.name: TransactionRow

props.name: amount
props.description: Positive number. Direction decides the sign.

props.name: icon
props.description: One of the names in `icons` at the top of this manifest.

components.purpose: One transaction: merchant, category, date, amount and status. The row reads as one sentence for screen readers.
whenToUse: Activity lists, statements.
whenNotToUse: Other kinds of rows: use ListItem.
contentGuidelines: Merchant names as shown on receipts; categories in plain words.
do: Use inside List or any `ul`.
Pass `onClick` to open details.
dont: Do not color the row by direction.
accessibility: One sentence: merchant, category, date, direction, amount, status.
The sentence starts with the visible merchant name, so voice control works.
